statement: Requirement HK-REQ-062 states that the local dev-server must bind to 127.0.0.1 by default, validate Host headers against DNS rebinding, restrict CORS to localhost origins, require a 32-byte random Bearer token on /api/* routes, enforce X-Hardkas-Request: true on state-changing methods, and set Cache-Control: no-store.
refined_statement: The local dev-server shall bind exclusively to 127.0.0.1 by default, validate Host headers against DNS rebinding, restrict CORS headers to localhost origins, enforce a 32-byte cryptographically random Bearer token on all /api/* routes, require the header X-Hardkas-Request: true on all state-changing HTTP methods, and respond with Cache-Control: no-store.

statement: Requirement HK-REQ-065 states that the offline license gate must verify that the required production dependency tree of all 22 published packages contains zero GPL, AGPL, LGPL, or unknown licenses, keeping snarkjs (GPL-3.0) strictly as an optional peer dependency.
